exceptions.rationale: The authoritative CVE record identifies Catalyst::Plugin::Statsd for Perl, not PyCA cryptography. PyPI lists cryptography 49.0.0 as the current release and 49.0.1 is not published as of 2026-08-08. This exception is temporary and must be re-evaluated before expiry.

The OSV finding concerns PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption and a Bleichenbacher oracle. AISearcharab imports only cryptography.fernet for symmetric authenticated encryption of MFA seed material and does not import or invoke PKCS7/CMS decryption APIs. A repository AST regression test enforces this usage boundary. Re-evaluate immediately if cryptography usage expands or a patched release becomes available.
references: OSV/PYSEC-2026-3552 as emitted by the CI CycloneDX artifact
